author: Voltaire
quote: Let us read, and let us dance; these two amusements will never do any harm to the world.

author: Voltaire
quote: Judge a man by his questions rather than by his answers.

author: Voltaire
quote: It is forbidden to kill; therefore all murderers are punished unless they kill in large numbers and to the sound of trumpets.

author: Voltaire
quote: Life is a shipwreck, but we must not forget to sing in the lifeboats.

author: Voltaire
quote: Those who can make you believe absurdities, can make you commit atrocities.

author: Voltaire
quote: The more I read, the more I acquire, the more certain I am that I know nothing.

author: Voltaire
quote: Common sense is not so common.

author: S.G. Tallentyre
quote: I disapprove of what you say, but I will defend to the death your right to say it.

author: Voltaire
quote: I have wanted to kill myself a hundred times, but somehow I am still in love with life. This ridiculous weakness is perhaps one of our more stupid melancholy propensities, for is there anything more stupid than to be eager to go on carrying a burden which one would gladly throw away, to loathe one’s very being and yet to hold it fast, to fondle the snake that devours us until it has eaten our hearts away?

author: Voltaire
quote: Love truth, but pardon error.

author: Voltaire
quote: I have never made but one prayer to God, a very short one: Oh Lord, make my enemies ridiculous. And God granted it."(Letter to Étienne Noël Damilaville, May 16, 1767)

author: Voltaire
quote: God is a comedian playing to an audience that is too afraid to laugh.

author: Voltaire
quote: Fools have a habit of believing that everything written by a famous author is admirable. For my part I read only to please myself and like only what suits my taste.

author: Voltaire
quote: Every man is guilty of all the good he did not do.

author: Voltaire
quote: I don’t know where I am going, but I am on my way.

author: Voltaire
quote: Dare to think for yourself.

author: Voltaire
quote: Now, now my good man, this is no time to be making enemies."(Voltaire on his deathbed in response to a priest asking him that he renounce Satan.)

author: Voltaire
quote: It is dangerous to be right in matters on which the established authorities are wrong.

author: Voltaire
quote: Despite the enormous quantity of books, how few people read! And if one reads profitably, one would realize how much stupid stuff the vulgar herd is content to swallow every day.

author: Voltaire
quote: The most important decision you make is to be in a good mood.

author: Voltaire
quote: Cherish those who seek the truth but beware of those who find it.

author: Voltaire
quote: Doubt is an uncomfortable condition, but certainty is a ridiculous one.

author: Voltaire
quote: God is a circle whose center is everywhere and circumference nowhere.

author: Voltaire
quote: The secret of being a bore is to tell everything.

author: Voltaire
quote: It is better to risk saving a guilty person than to condemn an innocent one.

author: Voltaire

quote: Think for yourself and let others enjoy the privilege of doing so too.

author: Voltaire
quote: Faith consists in believing what reason cannot.

author: Voltaire
quote: Every man is a creature of the age in which he lives and few are able to raise themselves above the ideas of the time.

author: Voltaire
quote: Appreciation is a wonderful thing. It makes what is excellent in others belong to us as well.
